sentences.text: This agreement is between the owner, Suresh Vasant Kulkarni, and you, Ananya Prakash Rao.
It is a leave and licence agreement, which lets you use the flat on these terms.
You may use Flat No. 304 at Sai Kiran Residency, Baner, Pune, with the fittings listed in Annexure A.
The agreement lasts 11 months, from 1 November 2026 to 30 September 2027.
It can end sooner only in the ways the agreement allows.
You pay Rs. 18,000 rent every month, in advance.
It must reach the owner by the 5th of each month, by bank transfer.
If your rent is late, you pay Rs. 500 for each day of delay.
If it is more than 15 days late, the owner can treat it as breaking the agreement.
You have paid a deposit of Rs. 1,00,000, which earns no interest.
You get it back within 30 days of leaving, minus unpaid dues and repair costs for damage.
You agree to stay for the full 11 months.
If you leave early, you must pay two months' rent, Rs. 36,000, and the owner can take it from your deposit.
The owner can end the agreement at any time with only 7 days' written notice, without giving a reason.
You can end it only after the lock-in, and you must give one month's written notice.
Courts usually do not allow this kind of term.
Your rent goes up by 10% every 12 months, including when the agreement is renewed.
The owner pays society maintenance and property tax.
You pay electricity, water and gas bills, and small repairs up to Rs. 2,000 each.
You can use the flat only as a home for you and your close family.
You cannot rent it to someone else, keep pets without written permission, or change the structure.
The owner can visit to check the flat, but must tell you at least 24 hours before.
The agreement continues after 11 months only if you and the owner both agree in writing.
If it is renewed, the rent goes up by 10%.
When the agreement ends, you must leave the flat empty and hand it back.
If you stay on, you pay Rs. 1,500 for every extra day.
If there is a dispute, you first try to settle it by talking.
If that fails, a single arbitrator chosen by the owner decides it in Pune.
